newsitem.title: USA: Stiglitz sees broad pattern of price stability.
newsitem.headline: Stiglitz sees broad pattern of price stability.

text.p: The White House chief economic adviser said a modest increase in the consumer price index showed that "the pattern of price stability is broad-based."
Joseph Stiglitz, chairman of the White House Council of Economic Advisers, said the CPI report provides "a picture of a strong economy with inflation in check."

"The August report for the core CPI showed price increases below trend across a broad array of commodities and services, indicating that the pattern of price stability is broad-based," Stiglitz said in a statement.
He said the Clinton administration's economic policies have created a strong and stable environment for long-term growth.
